Deutschly bundles the Ablaut German conjugation engine, version 0.11.0.
Upstream: https://github.com/ablaut-dev/ablaut
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0. See the adjacent license files.
The upstream project reports 99.2% agreement across 194,254 German forms
where its two reference lexicons agree. This is a measured benchmark,
not a guarantee that every possible form or lexical interpretation is error-free.
